sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Inhale, Tactile, Unaware), Water Release, Medical, Clash

system.description:
You clap your hands together, and fire blood from your fingertips forming a needle liken spear. All creatures in a 5-foot wide, 60-foot-long line, must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Blood Detonation. This jutsu’s range instead becomes a 30-foot cone.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 3d10 Necrotic and 3d10 Psychic damage as they are able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creatures takes 3d10 Necrotic and 3d10 Psychic damage as they lose the feeling of pain throughout their body. For the duration, each time the affected creature would attempt to reduce damage they take as a result of Damage Reduction (DR), they gain a -2 penalty to their DR, for this jutsu’s duration. If this reduction would reduce their DR value below 0, track it as a negative value, they take additional psychic damage equal to the negative value, up to a maximum of -10.

Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, except they instead gain a -4 penalty to their DR.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and both damage types by 1d10.
